title: Resume and profile a sharded training run
hardware: One CPU process with four actual logical JAX devices; multi-host/accelerator execution unverified

stages.title: State and input ownership
stages.evidence: Immutable sampler, exact epoch coverage, replay, row placement and tails
stages.expected: PASS stage 1: immutable sampler, key progression, complete epochs, changed seeds and padded tails
stages.diagnosis: If tail batches fail, inspect padding and cursor advancement before changing the model.

stages.title: Count-weighted sharded updates
stages.evidence: Actual four-device collectives, independent global/partition gradient oracles and replicated optimizer state
stages.expected: PASS stage 2: actual four-device collectives, independent NumPy gradients, unequal/empty partition counts and replicated momentum
stages.diagnosis: An average of local means is wrong for unequal or empty partitions; aggregate numerators and valid counts.

stages.title: Fresh-process complete recovery
stages.evidence: Durable full-state checkpoint, independent process replay across epochs, reset faults and corrupt-contract rejection
stages.expected: PASS stage 3: fresh-process complete replay, metadata/corruption rejection and observable momentum/cursor/key faults
stages.diagnosis: Matching weights at restore is insufficient; compare future IDs, losses, momentum and random progression.

stages.title: Trace-backed performance evidence
stages.evidence: Actual StableHLO, synchronized compiled single/four-device baselines, XPlane/Perfetto trace and explained plots
stages.expected: PASS stage 4: lowered/compiled equivalence, synchronized warm samples, actual XPlane/Perfetto trace and source-bound plotted evidence
stages.diagnosis: Separate compilation, preparation/placement and ready-output timing; logical CPU devices do not establish distributed hardware scaling.

rubric: Carry complete momentum, random, permutation, cursor and step state through pure transitions
Preserve every example with padded valid masks and reject unsupported input contracts
Verify actual four-device global mean gradients with independent NumPy and count-weighted partition oracles
Inspect real collective IR and each replica placement
Restore in a fresh process and compare sample IDs and full future state across epoch boundaries
Expose missing momentum, cursor and key as measurable failure cases
Separate compilation, warmed synchronized execution and traced preparation/placement overhead
Compare compiled single-device and four-logical-device baselines without claiming hardware scaling
Preserve actual trace, sample distributions, figures and source/environment receipts
setupNote: Use requirements-cpu.txt and a fresh Python interpreter. The checker configures four logical CPU devices before initializing JAX and executes a real small profile. The optional multi-host lesson extension remains separately unverified.
